summary: Completed comprehensive testing of WebAuthn/Biometric authentication feature. All 14 backend API tests passed (100%). Frontend correctly handles biometric unavailability in headless browser by showing 'البصمة غير مدعومة' (biometric not supported) message. The critical bug fix (webauthn_service.db = db in startup event) is verified working.
seed_data_creation: None required - existing test data used
context_for_next_testing_agent: WebAuthn/Biometric feature is fully functional. Backend APIs all working. Frontend gracefully handles lack of biometric hardware by showing 'البصمة غير مدعومة' message. The fix for webauthn_service.db initialization in startup event is verified.

bug_verification.original_issue: WebAuthnService had self.db = None because it was initialized before database startup event
bug_verification.root_cause: webauthn_service = WebAuthnService(db) at line 2279 was called when db was still None (before startup event)
bug_verification.fix_applied: Added webauthn_service.db = db in startup event at line 14484 to reassign db after connection
bug_verification.verification_status: VERIFIED - All WebAuthn API endpoints working correctly

webauthn_implementation_notes.graceful_degradation: Frontend correctly shows 'البصمة غير مدعومة' when WebAuthn is not available
